column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: mysql was DROPPED from this test's own dialect set (see the file's header comment -- MySQL migration 038 makes a second tenant impossible to seed, so there is no mysql subtest to skip), leaving mssql as the only skip in this PostgreSQL-only job. Measured by NAME: CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestGetSecretRefusesAnotherTenantsRowOnEveryApplicableDialect -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one, and postgres itself runs and passes. The mssql arm has to exist even where it skips: PostgreSQL and SQL Server enforce tenant scoping at the database by different mechanisms (RLS vs. a SECURITY POLICY), so a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the mssql arm's own enforcement.
